entries.relational_slices_section: Point CRUD and conflict upsert hardening
entries.current_evidence: Public SQL and REST/SDK-style typed row APIs now share committed-image RETURNING evidence for inserted rows, primary-conflict updated rows, primary-conflict do-nothing rows, claimed mutation-source updates, and claimed mutation-source deletes. The fixture compares SQL endpoint results with direct typed /rows/batch and /rows/mutation-source responses while local storage execution, insert-source, joined mutation, and merge RETURNING paths remain covered by the release gate.
entries.evidence_symbol: api http server executes SQL point writes through typed row batch ingress

entries.relational_slices_section: Point CRUD and conflict upsert hardening
entries.current_evidence: Conflict target upsert resolves expression unique owners, temporal unique overlap owners, partial unique predicates, primary existence, typed increment/patch expressions, and typed row-batch execution through the DB write path. The API write fixture now plans a conflicting insert with proposed/excluded state, existing row state, schema defaults, generated columns, sequence defaults, conflict guards, committed-image RETURNING, and participant version predicates, then proves a stale planned conflict action is rejected after an intervening committed write advances the row version.
entries.evidence_symbol: typed row batch conflict update enforces committed versions with defaults generated columns and sequence values

entries.relational_slices_section: Point CRUD and conflict upsert hardening
entries.current_evidence: Claimed mutation-source parsing rejects missing owner metadata, SQL lowering injects explicit row-claim metadata for non-unique update/delete mutation-source plans, invalid row-lock targets fail before planning, storage-bound row-claim tests gate execution, and hosted/provisioned write sources reject non-lockable CTE or source-side claim shapes before remote routing or owner-local staging.
entries.evidence_symbol: hosted mutation-source rejects non-lockable derived sources before routing

entries.relational_slices_section: Point CRUD and conflict upsert hardening
entries.current_evidence: Hosted mutation-source routing already gates stale topology epoch rejection, collect retry before staging, and global planned candidate staging. Typed insert-source planning fails closed when ordinary unique or temporal-overlap owner lookup reports topology movement before any write batch is staged, and the public API insert-source mutation endpoint now proves a source read followed by unique-owner topology unavailability returns 503 without invoking commitTransaction or batch.
entries.missing_evidence: Add hosted/provisioned range-movement chaos for routed insert-source conflict ownership. The proof still needs owner movement after successful source read and conflict-owner routing, across conflict guard evaluation, grouped write staging, and commit, then assert retry or fail-closed behavior without stale owner writes.
